nodes.label: Content Script to Background Architecture Diagram
nodes.norm_label: content script to background architecture diagram

nodes.label: Translation Stays in Background Worker
nodes.rationale: Page scripts never see API keys and CORS does not apply.

nodes.label: Closed Shadow Root Translator Widget
nodes.rationale: Plain DOM in a closed shadow root on a fixed-position host; preventDefault on mousedown keeps focus and selection in the page field.

nodes.label: Dependency Inversion for Translation Engines
nodes.rationale: src/core holds pure abstractions (Translator, TranslatorFactory, TranslatorRegistry, TranslationService) with no WXT/browser/provider imports so engines can be swapped without touching core.

nodes.label: execCommand insertText Replacement Strategy
nodes.rationale: Preserves native undo and is picked up by React-style frameworks; falls back to setRangeText or Range edits plus synthetic input event. If execCommand returns true, trust it and don't re-apply.

nodes.label: requestId Stale Response Guard
nodes.rationale: A counter makes translation responses arriving after the widget closes get ignored.

nodes.label: Selection Snapshot and isSelectionUnchanged Check
nodes.rationale: Offsets for text controls and a cloned Range for contenteditable are captured when the icon appears; before replacement it verifies the text wasn't edited during translation. Only text/search/url/tel inputs support the selection API.

nodes.label: Background Worker as Only Composition Root
nodes.norm_label: background worker as only composition root
nodes.rationale: background.ts builds registry and service and wires storageSettings; a translator is created per request from activeProviderId and providerConfigs so config changes apply immediately.

nodes.label: Typed Messaging Protocol (translate, list-providers, open-options)
nodes.rationale: Responses are {ok,data}|{ok:false,error} because Error objects don't survive messaging; new message types must update both Message and ResponseMap.
